high_level_description: The image shows a person sitting on a white couch in an outdoor setting at night. The individual is wearing a colorful tie-dye sweatshirt with the "Looney Tunes" logo prominently displayed in the center. The sweatshirt features vibrant colors such as pink, yellow, blue, and purple. The person is also wearing black pants and a gold watch on their left wrist. They have long, dark hair and are accessorized with large hoop earrings and a necklace. In the background, there is another person standing behind the seated individual.
